summary: v1.6 Veld art is live on the test build (merged 25 Oct, 18:56): new trees, fruit, far animals, the windmill from your photos, the dassie, clouds, a version stamp on every map and the Skietbaan's Fresh load button. v1.6b reload power-ups is finishing its tests (one slow Skietbaan test is being fixed). v1.7 meerkats is in its look round: the redraw is in, your notes on more fur and nicer faces are next. Then v1.7b (fruit that swings or drops), v1.7c (Namibië veld life: grass, ostriches, oryx in the mirage, balloons) and v1.8 Blikkies. This Project overview page is being built now.

needsYou.title: Pick the holiday Daily specials (Feesdae)
needsYou.detail: On a special day everyone gets the same themed Daily Hunt: decorations, one twist rule, Oupa's lines, a music sting and a special share card. Halloween is on 31 Oct: if you pick it, the job moves up so it is ready in time. Reply with the numbers ("1–9" takes all my picks).
options: 1. Halloween, 31 Oct: "Spookjag", a dusk hunt with owls, bats, pumpkin lanterns and guineafowl in witch hats
2. Christmas, 25 Dec: Christmas in the sun, tinsel on the camelthorn, Oupa in a Santa hat and shorts
3. New Year: a countdown hunt with party hats, small fireworks and double points in the last 10 s
4. Heritage Day (Braai Day), 24 Sep: the big braai hunt
5. Easter weekend: painted guineafowl eggs hidden for bonus points
6. Valentine's Day, 14 Feb: rosy-faced lovebirds fly through in pairs
7. Spring flowers (late Aug–Sep, one week): the Karoo carpeted in daisies
8. April Fools, 1 Apr: plastic decoy guineafowl, −5 and "Gotcha!"
9. Africa Day, 25 May: drums, every cameo animal out, "Did you know?" facts
10 (maybe). World Wildlife Day, 3 Mar: a camera-only Daily
11 (maybe). Women's Day, 9 Aug: Ouma's hunt (needs an Ouma voice)
12 (maybe). Workers' Day, 1 May: Oupa's day off, Brakkie runs the show
13 (maybe). Namibian Independence Day, 21 Mar: Namibië open to everyone, kept light
needsYou.blocks: The Feesdae job (Halloween needs it by 31 Oct)

needsYou.detail: No good free Afrikaans voice exists, so the interim Afrikaans lines are read by an English voice using Afrikaans pronunciation rules. Is it good enough for now?

needsYou.title: Final voices: keep the interim ones or get real voices?
needsYou.detail: Oupa is voiced with free interim text-to-speech in English, Afrikaans and German. Real or premium voices can replace them line by line later.
options: Keep the interim voices for now
Real voice actors per language (needs money and an account: you arrange it)
A premium text-to-speech service (needs an account: you arrange it)

v1.6b.summary: Two new crate power-ups. Blitslaai: for 12 s every reload is much faster, with lightning glints on the belt. Oupa Laai: for 12 s an empty gun reloads by itself and Oupa says so. v1.7.summary: Meerkat families live on every Kalahari and Namibië map: they peek, keep a sentinel, dig, dash between burrows and dive when you shoot nearby. Shooting one costs −10 (it is never hurt). Secret: hold fire while the whole family is out and they line up for a Familiefoto (+25).
v1.7.requestedBy: You, 24 Oct: "small meerkat holes … peek out and run from one nest to the other. Be creative."

They dive at nearby shots and the Langloop; the sentinel's alarm alerts the guineafowl

Familiefoto secret (+25) and the Meerkat Spotter climbing out of a burrow

suggestions.title: Retune the scoped .22 on the Kalahari's two farthest bonus maps
suggestions.detail: It scores 4,612–5,578 on Nog Verder and Die Verste, over the 4,500 cap every other long-range map keeps. It predates the meerkats. A small tuning job: fewer far-distance points on those two maps, as Namibië got in v1.4.

suggestions.title: Give the Kalahari the same grass and sand pass as Namibië
suggestions.detail: The Kalahari ground has the same black line between distances and the same scribbly grass. v1.7c fixes it there too if it shares the drawing code.

suggestions.title: A real Afrikaans voice for Oupa
suggestions.detail: The interim Afrikaans lines use an English voice. A real Afrikaans speaker would sound far better; it needs a person or a paid service, so it is your call.
